prose: The Wall Street Journal, citing documents and sources, reports that Google researchers worried about AI risks to children, including cognitive and emotional dependence, even as the company pushed AI into schools. The risks, together with falling test scores, are feeding a backlash. Based on the Techmeme excerpt; the article was not retrieved.
highlights: Google researchers raised concerns about children and AI
Named risks: cognitive and emotional dependence
Google was expanding AI in schools at the time
Falling test scores add to the backlash
